<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
update_option( 'blogname', 'Seva Foundation' );
update_option( 'blogdescription', 'Every rupee reaches the work.' );
$sample = get_post( 2 );
if ( $sample && 'page' === $sample->post_type && 'sample-page' === $sample->post_name ) {
	wp_delete_post( 2, true );
}
$pages = array(
	array( 'Donate', 'donate', 'donate-page' ),
	array( 'Transparency', 'transparency', 'transparency-page' ),
	array( 'Programs', 'programs', 'programs-grid' ),
	array( 'Impact Stories', 'stories', 'impact-stories' ),
	array( 'Volunteer', 'volunteer', 'volunteer-signup' ),
	array( 'Trustees', 'trustees', 'trustees' ),
);
foreach ( $pages as $p ) {
	if ( ! get_page_by_path( $p[1] ) ) {
		wp_insert_post( array(
			'post_title'   => $p[0],
			'post_name'    => $p[1],
			'post_status'  => 'publish',
			'post_type'    => 'page',
			'post_content' => '<!-- wp:pattern {"slug":"nonprofit-seva/' . $p[2] . '"} /-->',
		) );
	}
}
